milestone: M6B-1 explicit action adapter tiny pilot
generic_prompt: A first-person gameplay view in a retro 3D stone maze.
native_vace_o0_conditioning: Exact M6A-4 preparation: real O0 resized in memory, black mask frame0, white masks frames1..16, gray future placeholders. Preserve installed latent-mask behavior unchanged.
adapter: Embedding(6,32), ordered four-action groups, shared zero-initialized Linear(128,1536), fixed zero k0, add only to frozen noisy patch_embedding output before flatten; 198336 trainable parameters
target: Real O0..O16 VAE latents; loss on latent temporal positions 1..4 only

training.sampling: 50 deterministic shuffled epochs over 16 clips; each clip seen 50 times

inference.prompt: A first-person gameplay view in a retro 3D stone maze.

primary_evaluation.flow: M5C-5 Farneback implementation and source sign convention
primary_evaluation.transitions: O1->O2 through O15->O16 only; align A1..A15
primary_evaluation.decision: A iff all four pass; B iff at least two pass; C otherwise
